This transformation goes beyond innovation.
It reflects our determination to take greater strides,
enhance transparency, and drive sustainability, as
evidenced by tangible results:
Three units (two factories and one farm) have
achieved Carbon Neutrality Certificates according

progress towards the Net Zero 2050 goal.
Vinamilk's corporate ESG data system enables
transparent, real-time sustainability governance.
100% of Vinamilk's factories and farms now
implement a greenhouse gas emissions inventory.
Since 2013, all Vinamilk factories have adhered
to energy management systems in line with ISO
50001 standards.
